artDefaults.promptSuffix: Three Kingdoms fantasy strategy card illustration, dramatic painterly 2D digital art, strong silhouette, ancient Chinese battlefield atmosphere, no text, no watermark, no card frame.

cards.title: 杀
cards.description: 造成伤害。
cards.prompt: Sha attack card, a decisive killing strike by a Three Kingdoms warrior, crimson spear slash across a chaotic battlefield, sparks and dust.

cards.title: 闪
cards.description: 获得格挡。
cards.prompt: Shan dodge card, an agile Three Kingdoms warrior evading arrows and blades with a blue-white afterimage, defensive motion and wind trails.

cards.title: 桃
cards.description: 回复生命并获得格挡。若生命不高于一半，额外回复生命。
cards.prompt: Tao peach healing card, luminous peaches and medicinal light in an ancient military tent, wounded warriors recovering, warm peach petals.

cards.title: 酒
cards.description: 下一张攻击牌造成的伤害翻倍；该效果不会叠加。
cards.prompt: Jiu wine power card, a fierce general drinks from a bronze cup before battle, red aura and rising strength, war drums in torchlight.

cards.title: 刺杀
cards.description: 造成伤害。若目标已有负面效果，额外造成伤害。
cards.prompt: Ci Sha assassination attack card, a Three Kingdoms shadow warrior lunges from behind torn war banners, precise crimson blade, tense battlefield dusk.

cards.title: 守势
cards.description: 获得格挡。若本回合没有打出过攻击牌，本牌本场战斗中格挡值提高。
cards.prompt: Shou Shi defensive stance card, a disciplined shield wall of ancient Chinese soldiers holding formation in rain, calm commander, blue steel light.

cards.title: 苦肉
cards.description: 失去生命，获得能量。
cards.prompt: Ku Rou bitter sacrifice card, a wounded Three Kingdoms veteran cuts his own arm to rally troops, pain transformed into urgent battle energy, dramatic red banners.

cards.title: 急行
cards.description: 消耗。获得能量；升级后抽牌。
cards.prompt: Ji Xing forced march card, swift cavalry and messengers race through mountain roads under command flags, momentum and clean tactical energy, Three Kingdoms fantasy.

cards.title: 焚营
cards.description: 能力。每当你消耗手牌中的牌，获得格挡。
cards.prompt: Fen Ying burning camp power card, a strategist orders old camp supplies burned into a defensive wall of fire and shields, Three Kingdoms night battle, painterly.

cards.title: 破竹
cards.description: 施加易伤。此后每当你施加易伤，每层易伤获得力量。
cards.prompt: Po Zhu unstoppable breakthrough card, a commander splits bamboo and enemy ranks at once, vulnerable foes exposed while golden strength rises, ancient Chinese battlefield.

cards.title: 调度
cards.description: 抽牌，然后弃等量手牌。
cards.prompt: Diao Du tactical dispatch card, messengers move command flags across a military map, troops redeploying at dawn, efficient battlefield logistics.

cards.title: 佯攻
cards.description: 造成少量伤害。若目标已有负面效果，抽牌。
cards.prompt: Yang Gong feint attack card, a Three Kingdoms skirmisher makes a deceptive spear thrust to expose a weakened enemy, quick motion, tactical dust.

cards.title: 蓄势
cards.description: 强化下一张杀。若手牌中没有其他杀，抽牌。
cards.prompt: Xu Shi gathering momentum card, a warrior lowers their blade and gathers storm-like battle aura before a decisive strike, restrained power.

cards.title: 破阵
cards.description: 移除目标所有格挡并施加易伤。若移除了格挡，抽牌。
cards.prompt: Po Zhen formation breaker card, a commander splits an enemy shield wall with a precise tactical charge, broken shields and exposed ranks.

cards.title: 布防
cards.description: 获得格挡。若本回合没有打出过攻击牌，降低一张杀或技能牌费用。
cards.prompt: Bu Fang defensive deployment card, soldiers set barricades and command flags before battle, organized shield lines, calm preparation.

cards.title: 仁德
cards.description: 弃 1 张手牌，回复生命并获得能量。弃杀强化下一张杀。
cards.prompt: Ren De benevolence card, Liu Bei-like noble leader gives supplies to wounded soldiers, warm golden light, banners of loyalty and compassion.

cards.title: 突袭
cards.description: 移除目标所有格挡，抽牌并施加易伤。升级后变为 0 费。
cards.prompt: Tu Xi surprise raid card, Zhang Liao-style cavalry bursts from fog into enemy camp, stolen banners and startled soldiers, cold blue morning.

cards.title: 奇袭
cards.description: 消耗手牌中的技能牌。移除目标所有格挡，施加易伤并抽牌。
cards.prompt: Qi Xi cunning raid card, Gan Ning night assault with bells and black sails, a swift strike breaks enemy defenses, moonlit river ambush.

cards.title: 刮骨疗毒
cards.description: 消耗。移除自身所有负面效果；每移除 1 个，回复生命。若没有负面效果，抽牌。
cards.prompt: Gua Gu Liao Du bone-scraping cure card, Hua Tuo-like physician treats a stoic wounded general, surgical bronze tools, green healing aura.

cards.title: 空城
cards.description: 获得格挡。下回合开始时获得无实体，但该回合不能打出攻击牌。
cards.prompt: Empty Fort strategy, Zhuge Liang calmly plays a qin on an open city gate while enemy scouts hesitate before silent walls and drifting banners.

cards.title: 制衡
cards.description: 可消耗手牌并抽等量牌，额外抽牌。此后每回合首次打出技能牌后抽牌。
cards.prompt: Sun Quan balancing strategy, a young ruler rearranges military tokens and cards on a jade war table, advisors watching, golden command light.

cards.title: 无双
cards.description: 能力。每回合前若干次杀命中后追加无双伤害；追加伤害不触发杀命中。
cards.prompt: Lu Bu unrivaled power, an unstoppable halberd warrior surrounded by red-black battle aura, enemies thrown back, legendary dominance.

cards.title: 连营
cards.description: 能力。打空手牌后抽牌，并使 1 张杀或技能牌本回合费用降低 1。
cards.prompt: Lu Xun chain-camp tactics, burning connected camps at night transforming into flowing strategy cards, calm scholar-general directing momentum.

cards.title: 遗计
cards.description: 抽牌。每回合首次敌人即将造成伤害时抽牌；手牌少时额外抽牌并临时降低杀或技能牌费用。
cards.prompt: Guo Jia last strategy, a pale brilliant adviser leaves glowing scrolls and chess pieces after a wound, allies receiving hidden plans.

cards.title: 奸雄
cards.description: 获得力量。敌人首次即将造成伤害时抽牌，并强化下一张杀。
cards.prompt: Cao Cao ambitious hero ability, a commanding warlord in black armor gathers enemy schemes into his hand, storm banners and ruthless confidence.

cards.title: 鬼才
cards.description: 获得格挡。敌人即将造成伤害时判定牌堆顶，并根据牌型获得格挡、抽牌、虚弱或减费。
cards.prompt: Sima Yi ghost talent, a shadowy strategist manipulates fate cards under a cold moon, black feathers, calculating eyes, supernatural judgment.

cards.title: 英姿
cards.description: 能力。每回合开始时抽牌。
cards.prompt: Ying Zi heroic bearing card, Zhou Yu-like elegant general commands from a river warship, confident posture, banners and bright tactical light.

cards.title: 集智
cards.description: 抽牌。每回合首次打出技能牌后抽牌。
cards.prompt: Ji Zhi gathered wisdom card, a brilliant adviser unfolds multiple glowing strategy scrolls, clever tactical insight, ancient study and battlefield maps.

cards.title: 裸衣
cards.description: 每回合开始时强化下一张杀。
cards.prompt: Luo Yi bare-armored assault card, a fierce Three Kingdoms warrior casts aside heavy armor and prepares a brutal decisive strike, raw strength.

cards.title: 铁骑
cards.description: 每回合首次杀命中后施加易伤。
cards.prompt: Tie Qi iron cavalry card, Ma Chao-like armored cavalry charge crashes through enemy lines, dust, lances, unstoppable momentum.

cards.title: 青囊
cards.description: 回复生命。每回合开始时回复生命。
cards.prompt: Qing Nang medical manual card, Hua Tuo-like physician opens a jade-green healing scroll in a military tent, herbs, calm restorative glow.

cards.title: 枭姬
cards.description: 获得能量。每当你替换装备时抽牌。
cards.prompt: Xiao Ji owl princess card, Sun Shangxiang-like warrior princess swaps elegant weapons and armor with swift confidence, ornate armory, lively motion.

cards.title: 浴血形态
cards.description: 每回合开始时失去生命，获得能量。
cards.prompt: Bath of Blood boss power card, a wounded Three Kingdoms berserker general stands in red rain and burning banners, blood-red aura becomes raw energy, heroic but dangerous, painterly dramatic fantasy.

cards.title: 夜幕形态
cards.description: 每回合开始时抽牌，并对所有敌人施加中毒。
cards.prompt: Nightfall Scheme boss power card, a masked Three Kingdoms assassin-strategist moves through moonlit black-blue silk banners, poison mist and hidden scrolls, elegant lethal tactics, no text.

cards.title: 雷诏形态
cards.description: 每回合开始时获得雷势，并对所有敌人造成伤害。
cards.prompt: Thunder Mandate boss power card, a mechanical Zhuge Liang-inspired strategist raises a bronze command tablet as lightning powers wooden automata, storm clouds and golden thunder arcs, ancient Chinese fantasy technology.

cards.title: 魂医形态
cards.description: 每回合开始时回复生命，所有敌人失去生命。
cards.prompt: Soul Healer boss power card, a ghostly Hua Tuo-like physician opens a jade medical scroll, green healing light flows to the hero while pale spirits drain enemies, solemn Three Kingdoms fantasy.

cards.title: 诏令形态
cards.description: 每回合开始时获得能量并强化下一张杀。
cards.prompt: Imperial Edict boss power card, a young Han regent holds a glowing golden imperial decree above a sovereign sword, court banners and battlefield dawn, noble command energy, painterly Chinese fantasy.
